// Reference module grids of versions 1, 2, 6, 7 and 10 at levels L and M, in byte mode,

//   qrencode -t ASCII -8 -m 0 -l LEVEL -v VERSION -o - TEXT

// mask itself: the texts were searched until every mask was used at least once.
// Rewrite with: sh scripts/go-tool.sh test ./internal/qr/ -run WriteReferenceGrids -record-qrencode
